parameters.name: LoadBalancerId
parameters.description: The ID of the CLB instance.

parameters.name: LogsDownloadAttributes
parameters.description:
The access log forwarding rule. Parameters:

*   **LogProject**: the name of the project of Simple Log Service.
*   **LogStore**: the name of the Logstore of Simple Log Service.
*   **LoadBalancerId**: the ID of the CLB instance.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region ID of the CLB instance.

You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~27584~~) operation to query the most recent region list.

parameters.name: Tags
parameters.description:
The tags that are added to the CLB instance. The tags must be key-value pairs that are contained in a JSON dictionary.

You can specify up to 10 tags in each call.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun slb set-access-logs-download-attribute --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --tags tagKey_:_Key1_,_tagValue_:_Value1 --load-balancer-id lb-bp1b6c719dfa08ex00000 --logs-download-attributes logProject_:_my-project_,_LogStore_:_my-log-store_,_LoadBalancerId_:_lb-uf68ps3rekbljmdb00000 --api-version 2014-05-15 --region cn-hangzhou
